Room.title: CoupleCam Room
Room.description: Real-time multiplayer room state and WebRTC SDP signaling for a 2-player CoupleCam session.

hostName.description: Display name of the host player who created the room.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player once joined (empty string while waiting).

currentGame.description: Currently active screen or mini-game identifier.

scores.description: Map of mini-game score counters for the current session.

offer.description: Latest WebRTC SDP offer created by the host (or null before negotiation).

answer.description: Latest WebRTC SDP answer created by the guest (or null before negotiation).

webrtcGen.description: Monotonic WebRTC signaling generation counter for renegotiation and ICE restarts.

hostHasStream.description: Whether the host currently has an active camera/audio stream.

guestHasStream.description: Whether the guest currently has an active camera/audio stream.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

RoomMessage.title: Room Game Message
RoomMessage.description: Real-time game move, dice roll, score sync, or emoji reaction event inside a room.

sender.description: Role of the player who emitted the message.

payload.description: Structured game event payload containing a valid type field.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was persisted.

IceCandidate.title: WebRTC ICE Candidate
IceCandidate.description: Trickle ICE candidate exchanged between host and guest for native RTCPeerConnection.

sender.description: Role of the peer that gathered this ICE candidate.

webrtcGen.description: Negotiation generation associated with this ICE candidate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the candidate was added.

/rooms/{code}.description: Active 2-player CoupleCam rooms indexed by normalized 4-character uppercase alphanumeric code.

/rooms/{code}/messages/{messageId}.description: Append-only real-time game events, moves, dice rolls, scores, and emoji reactions for a room.

/rooms/{code}/candidates/{candidateId}.description: Append-only WebRTC trickle ICE candidates exchanged between host and guest.
